# RQ-TEST-0002 — Causa semantic color system (one source, many criteria)

| ID | Acceptance criterion |
|---|---|
| COL-01 | The interface presents a deliberate, visibly coloured Causa identity and is not an effectively monochrome black, gray and white presentation. |
| COL-02A | Structural Forma theme tokens: deep navy `#14283F` for navigation and soft ivory `#F5F3ED` for the workspace surface. |
| COL-02B | Semantic Forma theme tokens: teal `#087F8C` for primary actions and selection. |
| COL-02C | Attention Forma theme tokens: amber `#E9A23B` for unresolved unknowns and coral `#D66B58` for contradictions. |
| COL-03 | Foreground and background pairs meet WCAG AA contrast: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and 3:1 for relevant non-text indicators. |
| COL-04 | Status is never conveyed by color alone; each status pairs color with text or an icon. |
| COL-05 | Print and Folio output remains legible in grayscale. |
| VIS-01A | Acceptance includes actual screenshots from the deployed exact SHA at desktop and mobile sizes. |
| VIS-01B | Acceptance includes deployed screenshots at iPad portrait and iPad landscape sizes. |
| VIS-02 | Automated token presence and contrast checks, keyboard focus checks, reduced-motion checks and an independent visual review pass. |
| VIS-03 | A grayscale-only interface fails acceptance even when functional tests pass. |
